member.name: T:ObjektRT.Core.Conversion.ModelToAstConverter
member.summary: Converts an (index-based wire model) into a rich AST. This is the direction tooling uses to analyse or re-emit modules that were parsed from ObjectIL text or read from an ORBT/FOB binary.

item.description: Flat dup; brfalse … br … bytecode produced by the canonical if/while lowering is reconstructed back into structured / nodes. Anything that does not match the canonical shapes stays as flat statements (semantics preserved, structure flat).
Method locals are emitted as local declarations at the top of the method body (the ObjectIL text convention).
The wire model has no field access modifiers; fields come out as public. Wire Enum types map to because the AST has no enum node.
try/catch and non-stack if/while condition operands have no AST representation and throw .
